upload_id.description: Opaque identifier scoped to this account and endpoint environment.

put_url.description: Direct write capability; never log it. Present only while pending and completion has not been observed.

expires_at.description: PUT capability expiration in Unix seconds; plan to finish the transfer before it. Refresh a lapsed grant by replaying initialization with the same key and descriptor before starting or retrying a transfer; do not interrupt an active PUT.

upload_deadline.description: Absolute submission ceiling in Unix seconds, tied to retention. Replay never extends it; this is not an estimate of transfer duration.

submit_expires_at.description: Inclusive submission deadline in Unix seconds, the first server observation time of the complete file plus limits.submit_grace_seconds capped by upload_deadline. Null until that observation, which submit itself records. Later inspections and retries never extend it. Submit immediately after PUT success; replaying initialization is optional.

job_id.description: Present after submission has been recorded.

retention_max_seconds.description: Maximum audio retention period in seconds. Audio may be deleted earlier after processing.
